thread:
Maya (Design): Dropping a new concept: side-by-side invoice compare mode. Two columns: Org view on left, Project view on right. Each row aligns the same line items to compare token splits and USD estimates. Figma: https://figma.com/file/compare123 :eyes:
Owen (PM): This would be great for customers auditing transfers between projects. Main asks: sticky totals, clear aggregation state, and CSV/JSON export for selected rows.
Priya (Frontend): Layout question: do we render two independent virtualized lists or a single synced scroller? Synced scrolling could be tricky but nicer UX.
Diego (Eng): Technical: sync scroll is doable with scroll events but be careful with large lists and reflow. Prefer a single virtualized index that paints both panes from the same data source for alignment.
Hannah (Data): Analytics: track compare.mode.enter, compare.row.select, export.click. Include comparison_pair ids and unit (tokens|USD) in payload.
Maya (Design): Copy idea: small pill showing "Aggregated by: Project" when aggregation applied. Inline unit toggle should live in the header with label "Show: Tokens / USD".
Priya (Frontend): a11y note on controls: make segmented toggle keyboard reachable and announce unit change. Also prefer 44px min hit area for touch.
a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: ensure synced panes maintain aria-live updates when rows change focus; announce "Now comparing X to Y". Use colorblind-safe palette for difference gradients and provide pattern fill for bars where color alone conveys meaning. Contrast for important numbers >=4.5:1.
Diego (Eng): Export: server can build CSV for selected rows; frontend will send selected_row_ids and scope. For large selections, return a pre-signed URL.
Owen (PM): UX nit: when comparing, highlighted delta should be prominent but not aggressive. Use subtle background for positive/negative and a small caret to indicate direction.
Hannah (Data): We can precompute deltas server-side to avoid client CPU cycles. Add an optional percentile column (p95 tokens) if customers want distribution.
Maya (Design): Animation: highlight delta with a 150ms fade. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also add keyboard shortcut "C" to toggle compare mode (documented in help).
Priya (Frontend): Keyboard nav: Tab to header controls, arrows to move between rows, Enter expands details for focused row. When a row is focused, sync highlight in other pane.
Diego (Eng): Perf guardrails: if rows > 500 switch to condensed compare (no sparklines). We'll surface a banner: "Large statement -- switching to condensed compare" with an opt-in to load full. (Copy TBD).
a11y-bot: Banner must be focusable and announced by SR. Also ensure contrast and readable copy for assistive tech.
Owen (PM): Next steps: Maya update Figma with synced scroller variant + condensed fallback, Diego to spec server endpoints for exports and precomputed deltas, Priya to prototype accessibility interactions, Hannah to validate delta metrics. Sync Friday 9:30am PT.
Maya (Design): I'll add a11y notes and example aria markup in the spec. Tagging @a11y-bot for checklist when posted. :white_check_mark:
